meta.title: Ocean Opportunity Radar demo pack: investor list (consolidated)
meta.sources_rule: Official sites via WebFetch; press/search snippets tagged 'snippet'. No Dealroom, Crunchbase, PitchBook or Tracxn used. Blank or null means not stated or not verified; no values were guessed.

verification_levels.read: official page opened with WebFetch this run or in w2/w3
verification_levels.read+snippet: official page opened and one or more press/search snippets added
verification_levels.snippet: search result summary only; treat figures as unconfirmed
verification_levels.name-only: named on another opened page; no further data gathered

meta.search_budget: WebSearch used 8 of 8 calls in this run.
meta.fields_note: ticket_eur_min/max are null when not stated; ticket_note carries currency or caveats.

investors.name: Sustainable Ocean Fund (Althelia / Mirova)

investors.notes: Seven investments by 2020 close (Mirova). Mirova homepage fetched this run: no mention of the fund. Named 2020 deals (snippet): Plastic for Change (India), nextProtein (Tunisia). Early investors named in snippets include EIB, AXA IM and FMO; EIF not named.
